infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Pulze needs camera access so you can take photos for your posts and profile.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pulze needs photo library access so you can share photos in your posts and update your profile picture.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Pulze uses Face ID to securely lock the app.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Pulze uses your location to show nearby venues, calculate distance, and support location-based check-ins.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: If you enable Location-based check-ins, Pulze uses your location in the background to detect when you arrive at participating venues and prompt you to check in.
